install.detail: build v Dockeru ~6 min celkem, bez releasu; runc musi byt 1.1.x; 2 daemony+shim/VM; Apache-2.0; bez uctu

headless.detail: sudo + ctr/fcvm bez TTY; ctr exec musi mit </dev/null

adapter.detail: orchestrator/adapters/fc_ctr.py create/exec/destroy funguji; stdin EOF se neprenasi, tar jen pres head -c N

egress.detail: ven (IP, metadata, LAN, DNS) closed; ale host (10.201.77.1:22, <host>:22/4000) otevreny; allowlist neimplementovan

gateway.detail: LLM GW pres publikovany host port <host>:4000 dosazitelna, pkg-gw ne; identita = zdrojova IP VM 10.201.77.x (neovereno na gw)

compose.detail: 15/15 healthy za ~20 s ve VM s privileged dind, nutne rucni cgroup mount + --allow-direct-routing; nslookup fail (apk bez internetu)

isolation.detail: oddelene disky; VM se vidi po L2; host dosazitelny

lifecycle.detail: cleanup ok, 3 paralelne ok (~12 s), pause/resume ok, VM snapshot neexistuje

verdict: Funguje jako microVM runtime s tvrdou KVM izolaci a defaultne bez egressu, ale je to low-level stavebnice (vlastni build, runc 1.1.x, stary 4.14 kernel, bez EOF na stdin, bez egress allowlistu/credential injection ani VM snapshotu). Compose bezi jen s privileged dind a rucnimi upravami; pro PoC je to vice prace nez Docker/gVisor.
